# Introduction to Fermi-Hubbard model
$$
H=−t\sum_{\langle i,j\rangle, \sigma} (c_{i\sigma}^\dagger c_{j\sigma} + c_{j\sigma}^\dagger c_{i\sigma}) + U\sum_i n_{i\uparrow} n_{i\downarrow},
$$

# Pairing mode

Given the Fermi-Hubbard model, we sometimes caring about its pairing mode.
Specifically, the operator:

$$
\Delta_{\delta}(i) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} (c_{i\uparrow} c_{i+\delta, \downarrow} - c_{i\downarrow} c_{i+\delta, \uparrow}), \quad \delta = \pm \hat{x}, \pm \hat{y},
$$

is the pairing operator.
